messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + 429 rate detected for gateway-prod. Error rate spike started ~1812345600. Paging oncall.
alex_ong: I'm on it, grabbing charts. seeing 429s from quota-service and cascaded 502s from gateway.
marta_liu: yup same. dashboards showing a sudden QoS change in quota-policy v2 rollout. @raj_patel can you confirm recent deploys?
raj_patel: I merged a tiny quota-policy change 12m ago to adjust per-customer burst windows. It touched the global quota rollup path. rolling back now (PR #4523).
ops-bot: executing: kubectl rollout undo deployment/quota-service -n prod
alex_ong: logs from gateway:
```
2026-03-14T18:31:02Z gateway ERROR 502 upstream_timeout model-host-1
2026-03-14T18:31:03Z gateway WARN 429 quota_exceeded policy=global-rollup user=acct-xxxxx
2026-03-14T18:31:04Z gateway ERROR 504 kvcache-miss overflow
```
sasha_ng: customers complaining in support: several high-traffic tenants seeing timeouts. initial triage: ~7% of all requests are 5xx, 10% 429s in last 10m.
alex_ong: mapping traces — requests that hit quota-service and then fall back to slower retry path; backlog grows causing timeouts in model routing.
raj_patel: rollback started, pod recreates in progress. watching readiness.
marta_liu: mitigations we should consider in parallel:
- temporarily increase quota cap for prod tenant pool
- enable emergency bypass for internal control plane to reduce hops
- add rate-limit headers to degrade clients gracefully
alex_ong: I can flip a soft-limit throttle to let-through 20% extra capacity for 10m. Doing: `rbacctl set-quota --env prod --soft-increase 20 --ttl 600`
ops-bot: cmd accepted, change propagated to 3 regions.
sasha_ng: notifying support and account execs: "We're aware, mitigation in progress; might see transient errors for ~15-30m." (sent)
marta_liu: after rollback, quota-service pods are back but metrics still noisy. Looks like some API servers have stale policy cache. invalidating cache across nodes.
alex_ong: running cache invalidation:
```
for node in $(kubectl get nodes -l zone=prod -o name); do kubectl exec $node -- /bin/cachectl invalidate quota-policy; done
```
raj_patel: cache invalidation ACK, monitoring.
ops-bot: cache invalidation completed on 12 nodes.
alex_ong: error rates dropped from 10%->3% 5xx and 429s down to 2% within 90s after cache clear + soft-increase.
sasha_ng: support update: "Errors reduced, continuing to monitor; will follow up if anything else." :thumbsup:
marta_liu: action items post-incident:
- revert rollout gating to require policy-cache invalidation step (owner: raj_patel)
- add automated canary to quota-policy that watches 429/5xx % and auto-rolls-back (owner: alex_ong)
- add runbook entry for emergency soft-quota increases (owner: marta_liu)
raj_patel: I'll open PR to add cache-invalidate hook and stricter tests. ETA 2 hours for PR + CI.
alex_ong: adding temporary postmortem note to incidents folder and will attach traces. Also capturing affected tenant list.
sasha_ng: preliminary customer impact: ~18 paid tenants had visible degradation, 4 had >50% error impact for short windows. No data loss reported, only availability issues.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation state CHANGED -> partial-mitigated by oncall at 1812345940
alex_ong: handing off to next on-call for watch — @marta_liu will stay as primary for next 1h, I'm dropping to support channel.
marta_liu: I'll keep monitoring and coordinate postmortem. thanks team.
raj_patel: follow-up: scheduling a small maintenance window to re-deploy with cache-invalidate hook tonight.
ops-bot: note: created incident ticket #INC-20260314-07, assigned to eng-sre.
alex_ong: final note: root cause appears to be a misapplied quota-policy change that caused cache divergence + aggressive enforcement -> cascade of 429s that opened gateways to 5xx timeouts. Rollback + cache invalidation + soft-throttle workaround restored service.
sasha_ng: marking as resolved in support once we confirm stable for 30m.
marta_liu: thanks all. adding owners to postmortem doc and scheduling the RCA in SMT doc. :white_check_mark:
